__prompts__.project_description: Project description (one line, reused in the README and the --help text)
__prompts__.project_keywords: PyPI keywords (comma-separated, e.g. `cli,downloader,manga`; leave empty for none)
__prompts__.github_username: GitHub username (owner in the repository, badge and image URLs)

python_version.__prompt__: Minimum supported Python version (classifiers are emitted up to 3.14)

project_type.cli: cli - adds cli.py, __main__.py and a console script

use_docker.__prompt__: Add a Dockerfile and the multi-arch GHCR jobs in release.yml?

use_distroless.__prompt__: Run the image on a distroless base instead of python:*-slim?

use_pyinstaller.__prompt__: Add packaging/ and build-binaries.yml for standalone binaries?

__prompts__.min_age: Days a release must age before it is used (mise installs, Dependabot cooldowns, mise run pinup)

create_github_repo.__prompt__: Create the private GitHub repository with `gh` and push the first commit?
